rules.rationale: One person must not both enter and approve a supplier payment (payment fraud).
Posting journals and approving payables allows concealment of fraudulent payments.
Creating or changing employees and running payroll enables ghost-employee fraud.
Infrastructure admins must not be the sole reviewers of logs that record their own actions.
Stock movements must be approved by someone other than the operator.
A CRM administrator must not also own pipeline whose records they can alter.
